# Attribute reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_attribute_docs.py -- do not edit by hand. -->

Every attribute tlang understands, generated from the registry that also drives
parsing and validation, so this table cannot drift from the implementation.

**Scope** is where the attribute may be written: `global` attributes sit at file
level and attach to the *next* function; `function-body` attributes are pragmas
written inside a function. Using one in the wrong place is a build error naming
the correct scope.

**Stages** lists which shader stages accept the attribute. `any` means it is not
stage-specific. Using a stage-specific attribute on the wrong stage is a build
error that names the stages it *is* valid on.

**Params** shows each argument's name, type, permitted values (`∈ {...}`) and
default. Values are coerced to the declared type, so `[frag(early_tests=false)]`
is a real boolean `False`, not the truthy string `"false"`.

| Name | Scope | Stages | Params | Aliases | Summary | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `branch` | function-body | any | — | — | Requests explicit branching. | `[branch]` |
| `buffer` | global | any | layout: str ∈ {std430,std140} = 'std430'; name: str = None | — | Declares an SSBO block from the following struct, or from a single declarator ('[buffer] vec2 x[];'), which binds by the member's own name -- the emitted GLSL block name is synthesised and never binds to anything. Override the handle with name='...'. | `[buffer(std430)]`<br>`struct Particles { vec4 pos[]; };`<br>`[buffer] vec2 ptcPositions[];` |
| `ccw` | global | tese | — | — | Tess-eval winding: counter-clockwise. | `[ccw]` |
| `cw` | global | tese | — | — | Tess-eval winding: clockwise. | `[cw]` |
| `early_fragment_tests` | global | frag | — | — | Shorthand for [frag(early_tests=true)]. | `[early_fragment_tests]` |
| `equal_spacing` | global | tese | — | even | Tess-eval spacing: equal_spacing. | `[equal_spacing]` |
| `export` | global | any | — | — | Marks a non-stage function as part of this module's public (includable) surface. | `[export]` |
| `extend` | global | any | — | — | Enables a GLSL extension (or named extension group) with ': enable'. | `[extend(int64)]` |
| `extend!` | global | any | — | — | Enables a GLSL extension (or named extension group) with ': require'. | `[extend!(int64)]` |
| `extern` | global | any | — | — | Declares a host-supplied constant (int/uint/float/bool), emitted as a GLSL 'const'; resolved from ShaderManager(constants={...}) or the declaration's own '= default'. Replaces the '#define X {{ X }}' idiom where a typed, reflectable, checked-before-the-driver constant is wanted. | `[extern] int BLOCK_SIZE;`<br>`[extern] float WARP_SCALE = 1.0;` |
| `fastopt` | function-body | any | — | — | Enables compiler optimization. | `[fastopt]` |
| `flatten` | function-body | any | — | — | Requests branch flattening. | `[flatten]` |
| `fractional_even_spacing` | global | tese | — | frac_even | Tess-eval spacing: fractional_even_spacing. | `[fractional_even_spacing]` |
| `fractional_odd_spacing` | global | tese | — | odd, frac_odd | Tess-eval spacing: fractional_odd_spacing. | `[fractional_odd_spacing]` |
| `frag` | global | frag | early_tests: bool = False | — | Fragment-stage settings. | `[frag(early_tests=true)]` |
| `geom` | global | geom | in: str ∈ {points,lines,triangles,lines_adjacency,triangles_adjacency} = 'triangles'; out: str ∈ {points,line_strip,triangle_strip} = 'triangle_strip'; max_verts: int = 3; stream: int = None | — | Geometry-stage settings. | `[geom(in='points', out='triangle_strip', max_verts=6)]` |
| `glsl` | global | any | — | resourceblock | Escapes into raw GLSL: injects the text verbatim immediately before this function's body. | `[glsl(out vec4 fragColor;)]` |
| `include` | global | any | — | — | Pulls another module's exported declarations into this one. | `[include(math)]` |
| `isolines` | global | tese | — | — | Tess-eval input primitive: isolines. | `[isolines]` |
| `line_strip` | global | geom | — | — | Geometry output primitive: line_strip. | `[line_strip]` |
| `lines` | global | geom | — | — | Geometry input primitive: lines. | `[lines]` |
| `lines_adjacency` | global | geom | — | lines_adj | Geometry input primitive: lines_adjacency. | `[lines_adjacency]` |
| `link` | global | any | name: str | — | Inlines another function's body immediately before this one's, in its stage source. | `[link('helper')]` |
| `loop` | function-body | any | — | — | Requests an explicit loop. | `[loop]` |
| `max_verts` | global | geom | value: int | — | Geometry max output vertices. | `[max_verts(6)]` |
| `noopt` | function-body | any | — | — | Disables compiler optimization. | `[noopt]` |
| `numthreads` | global | any | x: str = '1'; y: str = '1'; z: str = '1' | — | Sets the compute work-group size (local_size_x/y/z). | `[numthreads(64, 1, 1)]` |
| `point_mode` | global | tese | — | — | Tess-eval point-mode output. | `[point_mode]` |
| `points` | global | geom | — | — | Geometry input primitive: points. | `[points]` |
| `program` | global | any | name: str | — | Declares a linked program, mapping stage kwargs (vert=, frag=, ...) to entry points. | `[program('default', vert='vs_main', frag='fs_main')]` |
| `quads` | global | tese | — | — | Tess-eval input primitive: quads. | `[quads]` |
| `require` | global | any | — | — | Alias family for [extend!(...)] -- ': require' semantics. | `[require(int64)]` |
| `shader` | global | any | stage: str | — | Assigns the shader stage of the next function. | `[shader('compute')]` |
| `stream` | global | geom | value: int | — | Geometry output transform-feedback stream index. | `[stream(1)]` |
| `tesc` | global | tesc | vertices: int = 0 | — | Tessellation-control-stage settings. | `[tesc(vertices=3)]` |
| `tese` | global | tese | in: str ∈ {triangles,quads,isolines} = 'triangles'; spacing: str ∈ {equal_spacing,fractional_even_spacing,fractional_odd_spacing} = 'equal_spacing'; order: str ∈ {cw,ccw} = 'ccw'; point_mode: bool = False | — | Tessellation-evaluation-stage settings. | `[tese(in='quads', spacing='fractional_odd_spacing')]` |
| `triangle_strip` | global | geom | — | tri_strip | Geometry output primitive: triangle_strip. | `[triangle_strip]` |
| `triangles` | global | geom | — | tri, tris | Geometry input primitive: triangles. | `[triangles]` |
| `triangles` | global | tese | — | — | Tess-eval input primitive: triangles. | `[triangles]` |
| `triangles_adjacency` | global | geom | — | tri_adj | Geometry input primitive: triangles_adjacency. | `[triangles_adjacency]` |
| `uniforms` | global | any | layout: str ∈ {,std140} = '' | — | Declares loose uniforms (default), or a std140 UBO block, from the following struct. | `[uniforms(std140)]`<br>`struct Frame { mat4 view; float time; };` |
| `unroll` | function-body | any | — | — | Requests loop unrolling. | `[unroll]` |
| `uses` | global | any | name: str; dir: str ∈ {in,out} = 'in' | — | References a declared varyings interface for this function's stage, in the given direction. | `[uses(VertexOut, dir='out')]` |
| `varyings` | global | any | locations: bool = True | — | Declares a flat varying interface from the following struct; emits GLSL only per [uses(...)] reference, one direction per stage. | `[varyings]`<br>`struct VertexOut { vec3 color; vec2 uv; };` |
| `vertices` | global | tesc | value: int | vert, verts, patch, patch_size | Tessellation-control output patch size. | `[vertices(3)]` |
